title: Flow Plugin Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Retrofit the already-V1-migrated 🌊️flow plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌊️flow) to the newly-amended Shape V2 tree-purity rule per 📋️TEMPLATE.md §14 in ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE. Mechanical only: move owner-root 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs (fix [lib] path + add ../../ prefix to #[path] strings), fold sibling variant files (config.rs, terminology.rs) into <folder>/🦀️component.rs, relocate buried 🛂️manifest.json to owner root. Do not touch 🧩️extensions/🏗️bim or 🔨️modules/🧮️compute (out of scope). No logic changes. Verify test count matches baseline (83/83) exactly.
summary:
Retrofitted the already-V1-migrated 🌊️flow plugin to Shape V2 tree-purity per TEMPLATE.md §14. Purely mechanical, zero logic changes (verified via git-diff byte comparison against pre-move HEAD content for every moved/folded file).

Moves:
- 📦️lib.rs: owner root → 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs. [lib] path changed "../../📦️lib.rs" → "📦️lib.rs". Added ../../ prefix to all 36 leaf #[path] strings (verified each resolves to an existing file on disk via script).
- 🎛️apps/🌊️flow/🦀️config.rs → 🎛️apps/🌊️flow/🎚️config/🦀️component.rs (byte-identical content; module name `config` unchanged, only #[path]/location moved).
- 🎛️apps/🌊️flow/🦀️terminology.rs → 🎛️apps/🌊️flow/🗣️terminology/🦀️component.rs (byte-identical content; module name `terminology` unchanged).
- 🗿️artifacts/🌊️flow/🛂️manifest.json → owner-root 🛂️manifest.json (byte-identical). Verified the graph-manifest generator (🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🧮️math/🕸️graph/🛂️manifest) discovers it live at the new location (ran `bun ./📜️script.ts generate`, confirmed flow's manifest listed among 12 wrote manifests, zero diff produced in its own generated output — no side effects elsewhere).
- Updated one doc-comment in 🎛️apps/🌊️flow/🦀️component.rs that named the old filenames (`🦀️terminology.rs`/`🦀️config.rs`) to the new folder paths.

Out of scope, confirmed untouched (git status clean for both): 🧩️extensions/🏗️bim/**, 🔨️modules/🧮️compute/**. AGENTS.md/README.md were already at the owner root — no collision, no move needed.

Verification: root-level cargo (check/test) was blocked all session by the documented norm dangling-manifest-path issue (`✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🔨️modules/🫀️core/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust` missing from disk) — not my bug, confirmed pre-existing/external. Used the TEMPLATE §3 temporary-[workspace]-overlay technique on the new Cargo.toml to verify in isolation instead (overlay fully removed afterward — final Cargo.toml diffs from HEAD by exactly one line, `[lib] path`). All four verification commands ran for real and passed:
- `cargo check --manifest-path .../Cargo.toml`: clean, zero warnings in semio-s-plugin-flow itself (only pre-existing warnings in flow_core/semio-framework-plugin deps).
- `cargo check --manifest-path ... --target wasm32-wasip2`: clean, same result.
- `cargo clippy --manifest-path ... --all-targets -- -D warnings`: exit 0, zero findings in our crate.
- `cargo test --manifest-path ...`: 83/83 tests passed — exact match to the W1 pilot's original baseline, zero drift.
Also wrote and ran a Shape-V2-aware taxonomy audit (ticket-local 🔍️taxonomy-audit-v2.ts, adapted from the pilot's V1 script) confirming: entry file correctly at 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, every #[path] target exists and carries the ../../ prefix, and nothing below the owner root except component.rs files / 📦️packages / plain folders / root data+doc files. Deleted the temporary overlay's nested target/ and Cargo.lock before finishing.

Noted but not touched: a concurrent session independently fixed an unrelated off-by-one import-depth bug in flow's own 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📜️script.ts (6 "../" → 5 "../", now correctly reaching repo root) while this ticket was in flight — left as-is per the shared-tree editing rules, not part of this retrofit's diff.

Registrar handoff: NONE NEEDED. Grepped repo-wide for both old paths (🔌️plugins/🌊️flow/📦️lib.rs and 🗿️artifacts/🌊️flow/🛂️manifest.json) — zero external references found. [lib] path is internal-to-crate; root Cargo.toml's member line for flow (.../📦️packages/🦀️rust) is unchanged.
